title: DataDo.me: AI Data Quality Enhancer
summary: An automated data cleaning and pre-processing tool that detects duplicates, imputes missing values, removes outliers, and augments sparse or uniform datasets with distribution-aware synthetic samples. It calls SDV's CTGANSynthesizer via SingleTableMetadata in pre_processing/modules/synthetic.py to generate synthetic tabular data for augmentation.
